contributions.evidence_limit: The checkout does not bundle a font license/provenance note or pin the external stylesheet revision.

required_decisions: Confirm whether the selected chapter is owner-authored or licensed for public excerpt use.
Record public-use permission and credits for every soundtrack file, or replace the soundtrack with cleared/synthetic audio.
Record the font provenance and the intended public display/redistribution treatment.
Separate writing, creative direction, implementation, asset ownership, and AI assistance in the public case study.
Review the chapter for sensitive-content framing before any public capture.
claim_boundary: The repository implements a manifest-driven interactive reader with chapter-specific motion, layered audio cues, and reader controls.
The local checkout is clean at the observed commit.
No public chapter, soundtrack, font, AI-role, or hosted behavior clearance is claimed.
The synthetic appendix is not the product chapter and must stay labeled when shown.
